Messages.Author: Jon Stahler
Messages.Body:
Another scenario for consideration:

Let's say Vamp A is equiped with a vial of elder vitae.

Vamp B is bleeding the controller of Vamp A and has fortitude. Vamp A
doesn't have fortitude, but attempts to block. Vamp B plays Kiss of Ra.
Can Vamp A burn the vial to give themselves fortitude until the next untap
after the Kiss of Ra has been played? Or does it have to happen before? If
the former is the case, does the Kiss of Ra go back into the bleeding
methusalah's hand and the blood paid for the card returned to the vampire?
It doesn't specify when you have to burn the vial, so I was curious about
these things (and wanting a way to get around KoR when blocking). Thanks
in advance

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jon Stahler wrote:
>
> Another scenario for consideration:
>
> Let's say Vamp A is equiped with a vial of elder vitae.
>
> Vamp B is bleeding the controller of Vamp A and has fortitude. Vamp A
> doesn't have fortitude, but attempts to block. Vamp B plays Kiss of Ra.
> Can Vamp A burn the vial to give themselves fortitude until the next untap
> after the Kiss of Ra has been played? Or does it have to happen before? If

Either time is acceptable - any time is allowed.

> the former is the case, does the Kiss of Ra go back into the bleeding
> methusalah's hand and the blood paid for the card returned to the vampire?

No. Kiss of Ra was successfully played (meeting all the requirements to
be played at the time it was played) and the effects are already applied
(not "interrupted" by the burning of the Vial). Vamp A is in torpor, where
he will remain even if he decides to burn the Vial after Kiss of Ra has
been played.

> It doesn't specify when you have to burn the vial, so I was curious about
> these things (and wanting a way to get around KoR when blocking). Thanks
> in advance

Burn the Vial before Kiss is played if you want a way around it (before
you attempt to block, for instance).
